user.description: Log in with your 70mai account (the same one used in the mobile app).

data_description.server: The 70mai server your account is registered on. Automatic tries Europe, Global and USA in turn. You can also type a server address, e.g. https://int-api.70mai.com.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email and password, and that the selected server matches the region your account is registered in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the 70mai server. Check the server address and your network connection.
error.invalid_server: Not a valid server address. Use a host name or an http(s) URL, e.g. https://int-api.70mai.com.

fetch_alarm_videos.name: Fetch alarm videos
fetch_alarm_videos.description: Look up the uploaded clips of every alarm from the last hours again, including alarms already reported, and fire a "video" event on the alarm entity for each one whose clips are available.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How far back to look for alarms.

init.title: 70mai
init.description: Push: Home Assistant receives 70mai alarm notifications within seconds. While on, the 70mai phone app no longer gets alarm pushes (70mai sends them to one device per account).
